name: Summer Experience in Sustainability and the Environment (SESE)
org: Indiana University, Environment, Society, and Sustainability Institute (ESSI)
what_you_do: This is a free online pre-college program. It has daily lessons. IU faculty give live talks on climate change, biodiversity, environmental justice and more. You do hands-on activities at home.
who_can_apply: High school students interested in sustainability and the environment. Need a computer, internet access and time for group work during the program.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2027 cohort will open January 2027. Closing date and program dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply online when the 2027 application opens in January 2027. Questions: essi@iu.edu.
notes: Entirely online, so students anywhere can join. The page shows quotes from 9th, 10th and 11th grade alumni. Participants receive a certificate of completion.
